verdict.rationale: Rootly documents alert ingestion from monitoring tools such as Datadog, PagerDuty and Sentry, including email alert sources. Alert Routes send incoming alerts to teams, services and escalation policies based on user-defined conditions. Those conditions can evaluate alert sources, normalized alert fields, raw payload values via JSONPath, and team or service attributes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that ingestion and routing work as documented.
